article.title: Punishment for offences relating to accident.
article.content: Whoever fails to comply with the provisions of clause 12[(a)] of sub-section (1) of section 132 or section 133 or section 134 shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to 13[six months], or with fine 14[of five thousand rupees], or with both or, if having been previously convicted of an offence under this section, he is again convicted of an offence under this section, with imprisonment for a term which may extend to 1[one year], or with fine 2[of ten thousand rupees], or with both.
article.html:
187Punishment for offences relating to accident.

Section 187 · Chapter XIII · pages 103–104 of the Act

Whoever fails to comply with the provisions of clause 12[(a)] of sub-section (1) of section 132 or section 133 or section 134 shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to 13[six months], or with fine 14[of five thousand rupees], or with both or, if having been previously convicted of an offence under this section, he is again convicted of an offence under this section, with imprisonment for a term which may extend to 1[one year], or with fine 2[of ten thousand rupees], or with both.

Page 103

12 Subs. by Act 32 of 2019, s. 70, for “(c)” (w.e.f. 1-9-2019).

13 Subs. by Act 32 of 2019, s. 70, for “three months” (w.e.f. 1-9-2019).

14 Subs. by Act 32 of 2019, s. 70, for “which may extend to five hundred rupees” (w.e.f. 1-9-2019).

Page 104

1 Subs. by Act 32 of 2019, s. 70, for “six months” (w.e.f. 1-9-2019).

2 Subs. by Act 32 of 2019, s. 70, for “which may extend to one thousand rupees” (w.e.f. 1-9-2019).
